{{Quote|Haven't you got any letters after your name?''"<br />"''Nerfs can't read. Why bother?|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Hayca Mekket]], discussing the durasteel nameplate on her office's door|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[veterinarian]] [[Hayca Mekket]] owned an '''office''' in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], where she practiced medicine. Though she most commonly treated [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], Mekket's surgery was stocked with equipment for treating other animals such as [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]], and even could be utilized for [[Human/Legends|Humans]] if the need arose. However, the facility did not house technology for [[Blood/Legends|blood]] or cellular analysis, and Mekket contracted such services to a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. The door to Mekket's two-story building was adorned with a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plate that displayed her name; when asked why the name plate didn't also display the letters denoting her [[Doctor/Legends|doctorate]], Mekket commented that to do so would be pointless as nerfs were unable to read. Mekket lived together with a [[Gender/Legends|man]] above her surgery on the building's second floor, and her office didn't open for business until a [[Time/Legends|time]] after mid-morning, though she would make exceptions on occasion.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] visited Mekket's offices after the veterinarian assisted him in halting a degenerative condition that threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the aging [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. There, Mekket informed Fett that he was fully cured, and delivered the bill for her medical services in the form of a request for a large, [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Blanket/Legends|quilt]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
The veterinary offices of Hayca Mekket were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[May 29]], [[2007]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
